title: Noraxon myoRESEARCH™ Software Gait Analysis Evaluation and Orthotic Gait Correction in Reducing Diabetic Foot Ulceration Or Subsequent Amputation in Patients With a History of a Diabetic Foot Ulceration
official: Noraxon myoRESEARCH™ Software Gait Analysis Evaluation and Orthotic Gait Correction in Reducing Diabetic Foot Ulceration Or Subsequent Amputation in Patients With a History of a Diabetic Foot Ulceration
summary: Determining whether the utilization of Noraxon myoRESEARCH Software gait analysis Evaluation and orthotic gait Correction can reduce diabetic foot ulceration Or subsequent amputation in patients with a history of a diabetic foot ulceration.

interventions.name: Noraxon myoRESEARCH™ Software Gait Analysis Evaluation and Orthotic

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of healed diabetic foot ulceration
* Over 18 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

Patients who are:

* under 18 years of age
* non-diabetic
* non-ambulatory
* non-healed wounds.
